name: booster-pane
description: Open pretend Pokémon TCG booster packs by set in a side pane: card art in the terminal, a collection and pull stats

apiKey.title: Pokémon TCG API key
apiKey.description: Optional X-Api-Key for api.pokemontcg.io (20,000 requests a day instead of 1,000 and 30 a minute). New keys can no longer be registered; existing ones work until 2027-03-01. Sent only as a request header; never logged or cached.

artMode.title: Card art
artMode.description: card: the whole card. art: only the illustration window, cropped approximately.

source.title: Card data source
source.description: auto: TCGdex, falling back to api.pokemontcg.io when it fails. Or one source only.

python.title: Python
python.description: Python 3 with Pillow, used to turn card images into terminal cells. A command on PATH or a full path to python.exe.
